play.analysis: {"analysis":"Blade Tidwell gets the ball for San Francisco Giants in a spot where his recent numbers actually look superior to what Zebby Matthews will bring for Minnesota Twins. The Minnesota Twins offense that Matthews must navigate ranks 14th in OPS at .720 and has struck out 1233 times this season (8th most), indicating a lineup that doesn't consistently punish mistakes. San Francisco Giants' pitching staff sits at 4.37 team ERA (23rd), slightly better than Minnesota Twins' 4.64 (25th), and will be anchored by a pitcher whose walk rate has been reasonable relative to his strikeout production. Minnesota Twins' road splits are genuinely poor at 33-45, and they arrive here having gone 4-6 in their last 10 with a lineup that runs 25th in walks drawn (488 total), meaning they lack the patience to work counts against even moderately controlled stuff.
